paragraphs.text: Lluwen , sometimes affectionally called Lulu , is an elf druid from Lorwyn-Shadowmoor and a Witherbloom student at Strixhaven University .

Lluwen is a friendly but reserved Lorwyn elf. Considered a Faultless , his horns are long and curved. On Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, he was a hunter of the Nightshade pack, and wore sturdy green and brown hunter's leathers and carried a spear. In Shadowmoor, his horns grow thorny. Lluwen has always preferred the company of animals to people. He can be standoffish and rude, but will fiercely defend those he cares about.

Lluwen was born to elvish supremacists and considered less beautiful than his peers, marking him a Faultless elf. Lluwen himself was uninterested in reclaiming the lost glory of the elvish domain. Despite this apathy, he still feared the might of the elvish court and did very little to argue against their resurrectionist plans. He chose to play the part of an obedient son and leave the court at the first opportunity. He spent his life on Lorwyn as a hunter.

Around 4564 AR , Lluwen captured the vampire Kirol in the Gilt-Leaf Wood . He brought Kirol further into the wood, explaining that he wanted Kirol's knowledge on the premature awakening of Isilu. He presented them to High Perfect Morcant , and they explained that they and the other students had awoken it by mistake. Morcant was interested in destroying Shadowmoor entirely and took Kirol's explanation to mean that Isilu might be vulnerable to attack. She concocted a plan of using dawnglow as a poison to kill the great elemental, and enlisted Kirol to harvest some dawnglove from a part of the forest that had fallen into night. Kirol was forced to continue harvesting even when a group of rimekin were close to discovering them, but they were saved by the intervention of Ajani Goldmane , an associate of the Magibotanical Environments class's professor Liliana Vess . Kirol and Ajani fled the forest, and Lluwen decided to follow. As Morcant attempted to poison Isilu with the dawnglow retrieved by Kirol, they returned with their classmate Sanar and, along with Lluwen's help, stole the dawnglow from her, transforming her into her Shadowmoor aspect in the process.

After this, the students accompanied Ajani through another omenpath, going from Lorwyn-Shadowmoor to Shandalar and eventually back to Arcavios. At Tamira 's suggestion, Lluwen joined Strixhaven's cross-planar student program to escape the ruthless elven hierarchy of Lorwyn. He joined Witherbloom college, but had a hard time adjusting when he learned that Arcavios elves had much longer lifespans, and spoke in high-pitched voices that often were outside his hearing range. They bullied him, calling him a satyr and a goat because of his horns and hooved feet.

Seeking to broaden his horizons, Lluwen signed up for an excursion to Titan's Grave , on which Tam accompanied him. Lluwen discovered that Lumarets were able to communicate with each other, though Professor Fel didn't seem to believe him. He later witnessed a gathering of Archaics performing a ritual, and the subsequent abduction of Oracle Jadzi by the Dawning Archaic . While investigating with his friends, he was confronted by Chandra Nalaar , who believed that the disruption of the Archaics was due to the meddling of Jace Beleren . However, the Dawning Archaic returned, and in their efforts to fend it off, the students and planeswalkers fell into a chasm beneath Titan's Grave along with it.

While navigating the tunnels below the site, Lluwen and Kirol nearly fell into the trap of a daemogoth before they were rescued by Professor Fel. Delving deeper, they found the Dawning Archaic emitting waves of volatile, reality-warping magic, and Jadzi performing a ritual to calm it. However, the ritual was disrupted by Tam, who cast both Jadzi and herself into the nexus of wild magic, causing them both to disappear. With the chaos threatening to spiral out of control and kill them all, Lluwen was forced to finish the ritual himself, calling upon all his friends as well as the Lumarets to encase the Archaic in the force of their unity and stop its rampage.
